feed.title: Tech News - Latest Technology and Gadget News | Sky News

articles.title: Plans revealed for AI data centre at former power station in North Yorkshire
articles.summary: Energy giant Drax has announced plans to build an AI data centre on 4.5 hectares of land at its North Yorkshire site.

articles.title: Cyber attacks affect UK meat processing industry, top security official says
articles.summary: Cyber attacks have affected the UK meat processing industry, a top cyber security official has said in the wake of hacks that hit supermarkets across Europe.

articles.title: Prepare for cyber attacks or face empty shelves, businesses told
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence is "helping to industrialise cyber attacks" and is "highly likely" to be used in attacks on Britain's critical national infrastructure by 2028, the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) has warned.

articles.title: Greenpeace deploys boulders in North Sea to 'protect porpoises'
articles.summary: Greenpeace says it has formed an underwater barrier with boulders in the North Sea to prevent "destructive fishing" in an area created to protect porpoises.

articles.title: Sky News expands Arc XP partnership for a new app and website
articles.summary: Sky News has expanded its partnership with media platform Arc XP to provide the technology underpinning its new app and website.

articles.title: 'Everything is destroyed': Hackers target refrigerators in new cyber attacks
articles.summary: Cyber hackers have targeted fridges and freezers in supermarkets in several European countries including Ireland – causing temperatures to increase and food to spoil.

articles.title: Majority of funds stolen in cryptocurrency hack replenished, Binance says
articles.summary: Around 90% of stolen cryptocurrency assets following a hack on a major exchange has been replenished, according to Binance.

articles.title: Meta, TikTok and X lose hearing against UK watchdog over moderation data demands
articles.summary: Meta, ‌TikTok and X have lost a legal challenge against ‌the UK's regulator over the amount of information it is demanding under new laws.

articles.title: Yorkshire Water boss resigns after company given lowest environmental rating
articles.summary: Yorkshire Water has announced its chief executive is stepping down - a day after the company was given the lowest environmental rating by regulators.

articles.title: Crypto industry suffers 'largest bank heist in human history'
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency worth more than $6.3bn (£4.7bn) has been stolen from a major exchange - with one industry insider telling Sky News it is "the largest bank heist in human history".
